name: sum seed 0, ∃ over steps = probsum
logic:
Logic(
    ∧: AndProd(stable=True, eps=1e-06)
    ∨: OrProbSum(stable=True, eps=1e-06)
    ¬: NotStandard()
    →: ImpliesReichenbach(stable=True, eps=1e-06)
    ↔: Equiv(and_op=AndProd(stable=True, eps=1e-06), implies_op=ImpliesReichenbach(stable=True, eps=1e-06))
    ∀: AggregPMeanError(p=2, stable=True)
    ∃: AggregProbSum()
    SatAgg: AggregPMeanError(p=2, stable=True)
    (∀, t) : AggregProd()
    (∃, t) : AggregProbSum()
  )
